*   `?g B7`: Main concept is a Title/Brand/Name.
    *   `+ F10`: (Sub-concept group `g`) Cube on F10 (Grid/Network/Wire).
    *   `+ C7`: (Sub-concept group `g`) Cube on C7 (Electronic/Computing).
    *   `!r B8`: Red Sub-concept is an Expression/Quote/Words/Talking.
    *   `+ F10`: (Sub-concept group `r`) Cube on F10 (Grid/Network/Wire).
    *   `+ A7`: (Sub-concept group `r`) Cube on A7 (Television/Program/Show).
